subject: Updated Commit/Best Case Definitions + Micro-labs for Stage Hygiene
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: sales_ops@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated Commit/Best Case Definitions + Micro-labs for Stage Hygiene

Team —

Quick heads-up: Finance and Sales Ops have aligned on a tightened set of definitions for the forecast categories (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline). We ran a small pilot last quarter and saw better accuracy when reps applied the clarified criteria. To roll this out cleanly, we are doing a short guidance + practice sweep this week.

What changed (short):
- Commit: Deal has signed verbal agreement or legally-required P.O. commitment, budget owner has approved spend and implementation start date is mutually agreed.
- Best Case: Genuine buyer intent with clear timeframe within the quarter but missing one of the Commit gates (e.g., legal/PO pending).
- Pipeline: Early-stage opportunities without committed budget or clear implementation timing.

Key asks for sellers:
- Review the attached playbook (commit_bestcase_playbook_v1.pdf).
- For any open deals > $25k, update the forecast category by EOD Friday and leave a one-line note in the opportunity comments describing the gating item.
- Sign up for a 30-minute micro-lab slot (link in calendar invite/micro-lab-invite.ics). Labs are practical: we’ll walk through 6 real examples and show how to map them to the new definitions.

Why this matters: finance wants predictable commitments for quarter close and we want fewer manual forecast pulls. This should reduce last-week surprises and improve quota planning.

Attachments: commit_bestcase_playbook_v1.pdf, micro-lab-invite.ics

Thanks — please treat as high priority for Q3 planning.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

I can prep a couple of my deals for tomorrow’s first slot; which times are still open?

I can run the micro-labs this week. I’ve attached a short CSV (forecast_examples.csv) with 8 anonymized examples I used in the pilot — should make the exercises go fast.

Marissa: renewals where the customer has a signed renewal agreement and a confirmed start date should be treated as Commit; if the renewal is verbal only, it’s Best Case until legal/PO is complete. I’ll add a couple of renewal-specific slides in the micro-lab.

Operational asks: can Sales Ops enable a required comment field for forecast category change on opportunities > $25k? If yes, we’ll enforce via validation rule and track compliance.
